description: This file defines a class called CyclingIterator, which is a custom iterator that cycles through a given dataset multiple times, useful for training machine learning models across multiple epochs. It includes methods for iteration and supports starting from a specific epoch, making it suitable for dataset augmentation in distributed training scenarios.

classes.name: CyclingIterator
classes.description: An iterator decorator that cycles through an underlying iterator multiple times, designed for use in training loops to repeat data across epochs.

methods.name: __init__( self, n: int, generator_fn: Callable[[int], Iterator[_T]], start_epoch: int = 0, )
methods.description: Initializes the CyclingIterator with the number of cycles, a generator function to produce underlying iterators, and an optional start epoch.

methods.name: Self __iter__(self)
methods.description: Returns the iterator object itself, supporting iteration.

methods.name: _T __next__(self)
methods.description: Returns the next item from the current underlying iterator; if exhausted, it cycles to the next epoch's iterator until the maximum cycle count is reached.
